item.title: Version 1.2.25 (Build 20260915)
item.description:
What's New

fix(hotkey): keep a cleared hotkey cleared across settings reloads

Clearing a hotkey stores keyCode 0 with no modifiers, which loadPreferences

read back the same as a key that was never written, so the built-in default

came back the next time the settings window opened (#324).

Check for the presence of the stored key instead of its value, for the four

hotkeys whose default is non-empty: toggleHotkey, tempOffToolbarHotkey,

translationHotkey and debugHotkey.

A cleared toggle hotkey also matched a plain "A" keystroke, because keyCode 0

with no modifiers is what an unmodified "A" key down carries. Add Hotkey.isUnset

and unregister the hotkey instead of arming it; the other hotkeys already guard

on keyCode, which the toggle hotkey cannot use because it supports

modifier-only combinations.

Bump the build number to 20260915.
